req.title: Reject wrong method on /delete
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than DELETE on /delete.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /delete endpoint should only accept DELETE requests and return a 405 Method Not Allowed for any other HTTP methods. This ensures that the endpoint is protected against incorrect method usage, which is crucial for maintaining the integrity of the API. The test suite includes a positive test to confirm DELETE requests are accepted, a negative test to ensure other methods are rejected, and a boundary test to check the behavior with an edge-case method.

tests.name: test_delete_method_allowed
actions: Send a DELETE request to the /delete endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.delete('/delete')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_wrong_method_on_delete
actions: Send a GET request to the /delete endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/delete')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_boundary_method_on_delete
actions: Send a POST request to the /delete endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/delete')
assert response.status_code == 405
